description: QuickMind is a desktop AI assistant for Windows and macOS that supports dictation, screen-aware commands, meeting notes, and personal memory. It also offers a hosted read-only connector so AI apps can access a user's QuickMind meetings, notes, memory, and past commands with the user's consent.
summary: QuickMind exposes two developer integration surfaces on tryquickmind.com: a REST API at `https://api.tryquickmind.com/api` described by an OpenAPI spec, and a hosted remote MCP server at `https://api.tryquickmind.com/mcp` using OAuth 2.1 self-onboarding.
